items.lede: The state attorney general says she would ‘not hesitate to enforce’ the five-year ban signed by Governor Kathy Hochul The New York governor, Kathy Hochul , signed legislation on Wednesday that places a five-year ban on the manufacture and sale of toys powered by AI chatbots, including talking stuffed animals, dolls and robots that use the internet to hold conversations
items.title: New York bans AI toys, including those using internet to talk to children

items.lede: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
items.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York

items.lede: New York governor Kathy Hochul has signed into law a five-year ban on the sale of AI chatbot toys.
items.title: New York state bans AI chatbot toys for kids

items.lede: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has signed a bill that effectively bans the sale of toys with built-in AI chatbots within the state over concerns about what they might say to kids.
items.title: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signs ban on AI chatbot toys backed by $15,000 daily fines
